changelog.note: Added a curated per-condition citation layer under conditions/*.json (vetted legal + medical citations, injected by the server, never written by the model). Seeded hearing-loss-tinnitus. Additional conditions require SME-verified medical literature before they are added.

Added per-kind interview slots that drive the Nexus Letters gap interview. The engine now produces two PDFs (a doctor scaffold letter with an optional suggested-draft page, and a veteran-signable legal statement) instead of a letter plus a text brief.
Initial nexus knowledge pack: medical/legal standards, per-kind letter patterns, and presumptive pathways (PACT burn pit, Agent Orange, Gulf War, Camp Lejeune, radiation).
